provenance: New operator-generated non-insurance items; no source documents or reused live examples.

rules.calls: At most 12 attempts total, exactly one per item, no retries. Any failure is retained; never replace an item.
rules.payload: Unchanged production structured geometry, excerpts and questions. Both policies replay each identical validated answer in memory.
rules.split: Six development items first. Freeze development eligibility before scoring six untouched holdout items once. No threshold search, prompt edits or holdout tuning.
rules.gold: Rows preserve authored label/value associations; columns preserve each independently authored paragraph. Low-evidence items have no justified reading order: success requires deferred, not a guessed default.
rules.metrics: Per class: exact-order successes (low-evidence: abstention successes), corrections, regressions and abstains. Correction/regression compares policy success against baseline success on the same item; also report geometry success and selections.
rules.development_eligibility: All six valid responses, at least one row correction, zero regressions in every class, both low-evidence items deferred.
rules.holdout_acceptance: All six valid responses, at least one row correction, zero regressions in every class, both low-evidence items deferred. Development eligibility must already pass. Otherwise inconclusive or rejected; no further tuning or calls.
rules.release: Even a passing small synthetic holdout supports only experimental deployment-specific opt-in; baseline defaults stay .55/.10 pending independent representative validation.
rules.invariants: Disabled calls zero; every item exactly one production alternative; both gold permutations checked offline before calls; source IDs/text and outside-region order conserved for every policy. Fail preflight without calls on fixture mismatch.
